-- =================================================================
-- Description:	This gets a basic report for [ExtensionTelefonica] table
-- =================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_ExtensionTelefonica_Index]
@EntityId AS INT = 0, 
@Membresia_Id AS INT = 0,
@NumeroDeExtension AS VARCHAR(50) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
	
	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- This is a computer generated procedure.  DO NOT ADD CUSTOM CODE TO THIS PROCEDURE.

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @ExtensionTelefonicaFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		ExtensionTelefonica_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF(@NumeroDeExtension IS NULL)
    BEGIN
        SET @NumeroDeExtension = ''
    END

	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @ExtensionTelefonicaFilter (ExtensionTelefonica_Id)
		SELECT 
			[ExtensionTelefonica].Id
		FROM [dbo].[ExtensionTelefonica]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[ExtensionTelefonica].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @ExtensionTelefonicaFilter (ExtensionTelefonica_Id)
		SELECT 
			[ExtensionTelefonica].Id
		FROM [dbo].[ExtensionTelefonica]
		WHERE
			 [ExtensionTelefonica].[Activo] = 1 AND
         (([ExtensionTelefonica].[Membresia_Id] = @Membresia_Id) OR (@Membresia_Id = 0)) AND
		 (([ExtensionTelefonica].[NumeroDeExtension] = @NumeroDeExtension) OR (@NumeroDeExtension = ''))

 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[ExtensionTelefonica].[Id],		
		[ExtensionTelefonica].[NumeroDeExtension],
		[Membresia].[ClaveMembresia],
		[InformacionFacturacion].[RazonSocial],
		[ExtensionTelefonica].[Activo],
		[ExtensionTelefonica].[FechaDesactivacion],
		[ExtensionTelefonica].[DesactivadoPor],		
		[ExtensionTelefonica].[FechaCreacion],
		[ExtensionTelefonica].[CreadoPor],
		[ExtensionTelefonica].[FechaModificacion],
		[ExtensionTelefonica].[ModificadoPor]
	FROM @ExtensionTelefonicaFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[ExtensionTelefonica] 
			ON [ExtensionTelefonica].[Id] = filter.[ExtensionTelefonica_Id] 
			
		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Membresia]
		ON [dbo].[ExtensionTelefonica].[Membresia_Id] = [dbo].[Membresia].[Id] 

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[InformacionFacturacion]
		ON [Membresia].[InformacionFacturacion_Id] = [InformacionFacturacion].[Id]
 
END
